caseName: Altoona Publix Theatres, Inc. v. American Tri-Ergon Corp.
caseNameFull: Altoona Publix Theatres, Inc. v. American Tri-Ergon Corp. and Wilmer & Vincent Corp. v. Same

opinions.text: It is ordered that the petition for rehearing herein be, and the same is hereby, granted. The order heretofore entered on October 8, 1934, [post, p. 587] denying the petition for writs of certiorari is vacated, and it is ordered that the petition for writs of certiorari in these cases be, and the same is hereby, granted.
